title: The Portal Project
hook: The data this week comes from the Portal Project. This is a long-term ecological research site studying the dynamics of desert rodents, plants, ants and weather in Arizona. The Portal Project is a long-term ecological study being conducted near Portal, AZ. Since 1977, the site has been used to study the interactions among rodents, ants and plants and their respective responses to climate. To study the interactions among organisms, they experimentally manipulate access to 24 study plots. This study has produced over 100 scientific papers and is one of the longest running ecological studies in the U.S. The Weecology research group monitors rodents, plants, ants, and weather. All data from the Portal Project are made openly available in near real-time so that they can provide the maximum benefit to scientific research and outreach.
